description: U.S. Landslide Inventory and Susceptibility Map is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS Landslide Hazards Program. Landslide susceptibility models analyze different terrain features to show where landslides are more or less likely to occur. These maps are useful for land-use planning and reducing risks, and some have been created for some areas in the U.S. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Landslides. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
